mapper.select: SELECT MAJOR_FIELD_IDX, MAJOR_FIELD_CD FROM MAJOR_FIELD ORDER BY MAJOR_FIELD_IDX
SELECT MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_FIELD_NM FROM MINOR_FIELD WHERE MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = #{major_field_idx} ORDER BY MINOR_FIELD_NM
SELECT MAJOR_REGION_IDX, REGION_NM FROM MAJOR_REGION ORDER BY MAJOR_REGION_IDX
SELECT MINOR_REGION_IDX, DISTRICT_NM FROM MINOR_REGION WHERE MAJOR_REGION_IDX = #{major_region_idx} ORDER BY DISTRICT_NM

SELECT cl.CLASS_IDX, cl.PROVIDER_IDX, cl.TITLE, cl.INTRO, cl.MINOR_FIELD_IDX, cl.MINOR_REGION_IDX, cl.REGION_DETAIL, cl.PRICE, cl.PHOTO, cl.VIDEO, cl.START_DATE, cl.END_DATE, cl.CREATED_AT, cl.MAX_USER_CNT, u.USER_NAME AS provider_name, CASE WHEN md.MEMBER_TYPE = '프리미엄' AND m.STATUS = 'BEING' AND SYSDATE >= m.START_DATE AND (m.END_DATE IS NULL OR SYSDATE <= m.END_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_premium FROM CLASS cl JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_IDX = cl.PROVIDER_IDX LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP m ON m.USER_IDX = cl.PROVIDER_IDX LEFT JOIN MEMBERSHIP_DETAIL md ON md.MEMBER_DETAIL_IDX = m.MEMBER_DETAIL_IDX WHERE cl.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}
SELECT h.TAGS FROM HASHTAG h INNER JOIN CLASS_HASHTAG ch ON h.HASHTAG_IDX = ch.HASHTAG_IDX WHERE ch.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} ORDER BY h.HASHTAG_IDX

SELECT mf.MAJOR_FIELD_CD, mnf.MINOR_FIELD_NM FROM CLASS c INNER JOIN MINOR_FIELD mnf ON c.MINOR_FIELD_IDX = mnf.MINOR_FIELD_IDX INNER JOIN MAJOR_FIELD mf ON mnf.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = mf.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX WHERE c.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}

SELECT mr.REGION_NM, mnr.DISTRICT_NM FROM CLASS c INNER JOIN MINOR_REGION mnr ON c.MINOR_REGION_IDX = mnr.MINOR_REGION_IDX INNER JOIN MAJOR_REGION mr ON mnr.MAJOR_REGION_IDX = mr.MAJOR_REGION_IDX WHERE c.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}

SELECT u.USER_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME, CASE WHEN c.COACH_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN c.PHOTO WHEN co.COMPANY_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN co.PHOTO ELSE NULL END AS PROVIDER_PHOTO FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN COACH c ON u.USER_IDX = c.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY co ON u.USER_IDX = co.USER_IDX WHERE u.USER_IDX = #{provider_idx}

SELECT rc.REVIEW_CLASS_IDX, rc.REVIEWER_IDX, rc.CLASS_IDX, rc.RATING, rc.TAG, rc.CONTENT, rc.CREATED_AT, u.USER_NAME AS REVIEWER_NAME, CASE WHEN coach.COACH_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN coach.PHOTO WHEN comp.COMPANY_IDX IS NOT NULL THEN comp.PHOTO ELSE NULL END AS REVIEWER_PHOTO FROM REVIEW_CLASS rc INNER JOIN USERS u ON rc.REVIEWER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COACH coach ON u.USER_IDX = coach.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY comp ON u.USER_IDX = comp.USER_IDX WHERE rc.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} ORDER BY rc.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0) FROM REVIEW_CLASS WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM REVIEW_CLASS WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS_ENROLLMENT WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} AND STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND TRUNC(ENROLLED_AT) = TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{enrollment_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS_ENROLLMENT WHERE CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} AND USER_IDX = #{user_idx} AND STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND TRUNC(ENROLLED_AT) = TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{enrollment_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CLASS_ENROLLMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CLASS_ENROLLMENT ( ENROLL_IDX, CLASS_IDX, USER_IDX, STATUS, ENROLLED_AT ) VALUES ( #{enroll_idx}, #{class_idx}, #{user_idx}, #{status}, #{enrolled_at} )
mapper.select: SELECT ce.ENROLL_IDX, ce.CLASS_IDX, ce.USER_IDX, ce.STATUS, ce.ENROLLED_AT, ce.COMPLETED_AT, c.TITLE AS class_title, c.PRICE, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, u.USER_NAME AS provider_name FROM CLASS_ENROLLMENT ce INNER JOIN CLASS c ON ce.CLASS_IDX = c.CLASS_IDX INNER JOIN USERS u ON c.PROVIDER_IDX = u.USER_IDX WHERE ce.USER_IDX = #{user_idx} ORDER BY ce.ENROLLED_AT DESC

SELECT ce.ENROLL_IDX, ce.CLASS_IDX, ce.USER_IDX, ce.STATUS, ce.ENROLLED_AT, ce.COMPLETED_AT, u.USER_NAME AS user_name FROM CLASS_ENROLLMENT ce INNER JOIN USERS u ON ce.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX WHERE ce.CLASS_IDX = #{class_idx} ORDER BY ce.ENROLLED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CLASS_ENROLLMENT SET STATUS = #{status}, COMPLETED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ENROLL_IDX = #{enroll_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT ce.ENROLL_IDX, ce.CLASS_IDX, ce.USER_IDX, ce.STATUS, ce.ENROLLED_AT, ce.COMPLETED_AT, c.TITLE AS class_title, c.PRICE, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, u1.USER_NAME AS user_name, u2.USER_NAME AS provider_name FROM CLASS_ENROLLMENT ce INNER JOIN CLASS c ON ce.CLASS_IDX = c.CLASS_IDX INNER JOIN USERS u1 ON ce.USER_IDX = u1.USER_IDX INNER JOIN USERS u2 ON c.PROVIDER_IDX = u2.USER_IDX WHERE ce.ENROLL_IDX = #{enroll_idx}
